title: Knowledge Base and RAG for ElevenLabs Voice Agents
desc:
ElevenLabs tutorial: Knowledge Base and RAG for ElevenLabs Voice Agents.

A knowledge base gives your voice agent your own documents to answer from. This episode covers what belongs in it, the three ways to add documents, full context versus RAG, usage modes, how RAG works step by step, enabling it in the dashboard and as code, index limits per plan, the crawler user agent, managing documents over time, and best practices from the docs.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
